A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we study a dynamic market micro-structure model where an informed trader competes with a strategic market maker.
we provide a dynamic model for a competitive market with an informed trader, noise traders and limit traders, and we give a characterization of equilibrium in this market.
our model provides a dynamic market microstructural model that incorporates the presence of limit orders, the presence of noise and the presence of an informed trader.
